content_sections.heading: AFCAT 01/2027 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The Indian Air Force has announced the online registration schedule for AFCAT 01/2027, NCC Special Entry and GATE Score Entry. Candidates should note the application deadline and regularly check the official portal for examination and admit card updates.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 01/2027 Vacancy Details - Flying and Ground Duty Branches
content_sections.text: The AFCAT 01/2027 recruitment covers Flying, Ground Duty Technical and Ground Duty Non-Technical branches, along with NCC Special Entry and GATE Score Entry. The short notification states that the vacancy numbers will be published in the detailed notification for induction cycle 01/2027. Important: Branch-wise vacancies are subject to change according to Indian Air Force requirements, training capacity and other applicable conditions. Candidates should refer to the detailed official notification for the confirmed vacancy breakdown.

content_sections.heading: Indian Air Force AFCAT Recruitment 2027 - Branch Details
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for Short Service Commission in the Flying Branch through AFCAT Entry. NCC Special Entry is also available for the Flying Branch under the prescribed conditions. The Flying Branch age limit is 20 to 24 years as on 1 January 2028, with a relaxation up to 26 years for candidates holding a valid and current Commercial Pilot Licence issued by DGCA (India). Ground Duty Technical entry provides Permanent Commission and Short Service Commission opportunities in the technical branches of the Indian Air Force. Candidates may apply through AFCAT or the GATE Score Entry route where eligible. The age limit is 20 to 26 years as on 1 January 2028. The Ground Duty Non-Technical category includes branches such as Administration, Logistics, Accounts, Education and Meteorology. The short notice also lists Weapon Systems entry under Ground Duty Non-Technical. Candidates should check the detailed notification for branch-specific qualifications and vacancies.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 01/2027 Eligibility and Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for AFCAT 01/2027 must satisfy the educational qualifications, physical standards and medical requirements prescribed for their selected entry and branch. The short notice directs candidates to the detailed AFCAT notification for the exact educational qualifications and selection requirements. Candidates should verify the applicable graduation subjects, engineering disciplines, minimum marks, NCC qualifications or GATE conditions before applying.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 01/2027 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit is calculated as on 1 January 2028 . The branch-wise requirements are as follows. The dates of birth shown above are inclusive. Candidates must also satisfy the applicable marital status and other eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 01/2027 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The Indian Air Force has announced the examination fee for AFCAT Entry. There is no examination fee for candidates registering through NCC Special Entry or GATE Score Entry. The AFCAT examination fee is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 01/2027 Salary and Training Stipend
content_sections.text: Candidates selected for training under AFCAT 01/2027 will receive a fixed stipend of Rs. 56,100 per month during training. On commissioning, the pay for the rank of Flying Officer is as follows. Applicable allowances may include Flying Allowance, Technical Allowance, Transport Allowance and other benefits depending on the branch, posting and nature of duty.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 01/2027 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for AFCAT Entry, NCC Special Entry and GATE Score Entry must follow the selection procedure prescribed for the respective entry route. The detailed notification will provide the applicable selection requirements, including online examination, Air Force Selection Board assessment and medical standards. Candidates should follow only the official instructions for their selected entry.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 01/2027 Training Duration
content_sections.text: Training for selected candidates is scheduled to commence in the first week of January 2028 at the Air Force Academy, Dundigal, Hyderabad.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 01/2027 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for Indian Air Force AFCAT 01/2027 through the official recruitment portal at afcat.edcil.co.in from 12 November 2026. Separate registration options will be available for AFCAT Entry, NCC Special Entry and GATE Score Entry. Candidates eligible for more than one entry must register separately for each entry. Application Start: 12 November 2026 (11:00 AM) Last Date: 11 December 2026 (11:30 PM)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for AFCAT 01/2027?
content_sections.text: Visit the official AFCAT application website at afcat.edcil.co.in . Select the AFCAT 01/2027 recruitment notification. Read the detailed eligibility requirements for the selected branch. Choose AFCAT Entry, NCC Special Entry or GATE Score Entry, as applicable. Complete registration using the required personal and contact information. Fill in the application form with accurate educational and eligibility details. Upload the prescribed documents according to the portal instructions. Pay the applicable examination fee if applying through AFCAT Entry. Review all entered details before final submission. Save a copy of the completed application for future reference. Important: Candidates should verify all entries carefully before submission because the notification states that changes to submitted application information will not be permitted subsequently.

faq.question: Q1. Is the AFCAT 01/2027 notification released?
faq.answer: Yes. The Indian Air Force has issued the AFCAT 01/2027 short notice for Flying, Ground Duty, NCC Special Entry and GATE Score Entry, with courses beginning in January 2028.

faq.question: Q2. What is the AFCAT 01/2027 application start date?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 12 November 2026 at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AFCAT 01/2027?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 11 December 2026 at 11:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in AFCAT 01/2027?
faq.answer: The short notice does not confirm a total vacancy number. Branch-wise vacancies are to be published in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AFCAT 01/2027?
faq.answer: The Flying Branch age limit is 20 to 24 years, while the Ground Duty branches have an age limit of 20 to 26 years as on 1 January 2028. Eligible candidates holding a valid DGCA Commercial Pilot Licence may receive the specified Flying Branch age relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the AFCAT 01/2027 application fee?
faq.answer: The AFCAT Entry examination fee is Rs. 550 plus GST. NCC Special Entry and GATE Score Entry applicants do not have to pay an examination fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of an AFCAT Flying Officer?
faq.answer: The Flying Officer pay scale is Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 1,77,500 under Level 10, along with Military Service Pay of Rs. 15,500 and applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q8. What is the training stipend for AFCAT 01/2027?
faq.answer: Flight Cadets receive a fixed monthly stipend of Rs. 56,100 during training.

faq.question: Q9. When will AFCAT 01/2027 training begin?
faq.answer: Training is scheduled to begin in the first week of January 2028 at the Air Force Academy, Dundigal, Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website at afcat.cdac.in and filling out the application form before the deadline.
